articles.summary: Headlining the event will be NioCorp Executive Chairman and CEO Mark A. Smith and COO Scott Honan, along with Jake Whitefoot from Nebraska’s Gana Trucking and Excavating, who will provide an update following the launch of construction on the mine portal at the Company’s Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project.
articles.title: NioCorp to Host Live Webinar on Construction of Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project Mine Portal

articles.summary: Congressman Adrian Smith (R-NE) officially launched excavation last week of the Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project mine portal during a tour and briefing on the project with county and local Nebraska officials.
articles.title: Congressman Adrian Smith Starts Dig of NioCorp’s Elk Creek Project Mine Portal
